sample_size.label: estimate
sample_size.source_or_assumption: Per ISO 2859-1 table (edition not verified): code letter K for lot 1,201-3,200, level General II

defects.description: Cell swelling, punctured pouch, or cell melted by weld heat
defects.check_method: Visual + X-ray on 5 units, weld-line temperature check

defects.description: Card does not advertise / cannot pair, or radio out of FCC channel/power limits
defects.check_method: BLE functional test on 100% at end of line + conducted power spot check

defects.description: Total thickness outside 2.8 ± 0.15 mm or shells not welded closed
Buzzer below target loudness or silent
defects.check_method: SPL meter at 10 cm vs golden sample

defects.description: Flow lines, sink marks or shell warpage on visible face
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 / DFM m3 (measured 0.5 mm wall)
defects.check_method: Visual at 50 cm, D65 light + flatness on plate

inspection_cost.label: estimate
inspection_cost.source_or_assumption: V-Trust rate (Sourced) × estimated man-days: 2 man-days × $268/man-day (V-Trust, https://www.v-trust.com/en/our-network, checked 2026-09-26)
